From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Next steps: match calendars & confirm demo leads — CloudSprint

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today — appreciate the context on your inference workload and latency targets. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock a short product intro (30 minutes) with the right folks: 

Recap (one-liner each)
- Current: 3x models, mix of cloud/on-prem; peak 200 req/s, 95th latency ~250ms.
- Priority: reduce unit cost while staying under 200ms P95 for the top flows.
- Constraints: must include security lead for data handling conversation; transport and KMS questions expected.

Proposed 30-minute intro (high-level product + runbook for evaluation) — please pick one window (all times Pacific Daylight Time):
1) Tue 16 Jun 2026 — 09:00–09:30 PDT
2) Tue 16 Jun 2026 — 13:00–13:30 PDT
3) Wed 17 Jun 2026 — 11:00–11:30 PDT

Who we suggest on our side: myself (AE) + Priyom Das (Solutions Engineer) to run the demo and answer infra questions. Ben Carter is on copy to help with timing and any commercial prep.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one-pager), proposed-agenda.md (draft agenda).

If one of these works, reply with preferred slot and any other internal attendees (security/compliance/infra) and we'll send a calendar invite with the brief agenda. If none work, send 2 options that do.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

—
Kimberly Park
